name: Stinky's Escape
summary: "Stinky" Ignatz is out in the swamp, where Morgan Stern, a cook in Theramore, sent him to gather bogbean leaves. Critters have surrounded him, and he asks you to help him out and watch his back while he looks for a bogbean plant. Afterward, Morgan Stern in Theramore is the one to see.

sections.title: Surrounded
sections.body: Ignatz is relieved to meet someone who does not see him as a meal. He says Morgan Stern, a cook, is working on a new recipe and sent him out to collect bogbean leaves, which Ignatz guesses Stern finds tasty. While looking for a plant, Ignatz was surrounded, and he asks you to help him out and guard his back as he searches.

sections.title: A Cook Waiting
sections.body: Morgan Stern in Theramore is anxious: Ignatz set off for the swamp a while ago and is still not back.

sections.title: Thanks from the Cook
sections.body: Stern says Ignatz came by with the bogbean leaves and told of how you got him through his trouble. As thanks, Stern will ask an uncle to give you a feast when you next visit the Blue Recluse in Stormwind.

faq.answer: "Stinky" Ignatz was sent into the swamp by the cook Morgan Stern to gather bogbean leaves.
While he looked for a bogbean plant, the critters around him closed in and surrounded him.
Morgan Stern is working on a new recipe and sent Ignatz for the leaves. Ignatz guesses Stern finds them tasty.
Morgan Stern is a cook in Theramore who is working on a new recipe.
